summary.text: John Ricottone is the Republican, Conservative and Stop Mamdani Party nominee challenging incumbent William Colton. He describes himself as a retired NYPD officer and president of Community Education Council District 20. In his Ballotpedia survey, his stated campaign priorities are safer and cleaner streets, affordability and education.

paragraphs.text: Earned a high school diploma from John Dewey High School and an associate degree from Ashworth College in 2005.
Is a retired NYPD officer; Ballotpedia lists his profession as retired as of 2026.

Describes himself as President of Community Education Council District 20, where he says he worked to improve school safety, helped obtain $50,000 in City Council funding for one of his liaison schools, and pushed for school safety agent hiring and more after-school funding.

Advanced from the Conservative Party primary on June 23, 2026; the Republican primary for the seat was canceled. He is on the November 3, 2026 ballot as the Republican, Conservative and Stop Mamdani Party candidate.
